description: Change the signed-in user's availability on their Foundaree profile: available (free for work now), open_to_offers (working, but will listen), or not_looking. This is public and it changes who finds them in search, so confirm with the user before calling it. Useful when they say they have finished a job, are fully booked, or want to be found again.

availability.description: The state to set on the profile.

name: set_my_availability
title: Set whether the user is free for work
